# EGIRE Robotics

> EGIRE Robotics is an Indian FPV drone, AI and robotics training company. It runs FPV piloting workshops, drone building courses, simulator training and a 90-day course for students, colleges and professionals across India, and supplies drone spares.

Website: https://www.egirerobotics.com
Email: contact@egirerobotics.com
Phone: +91 8500126104 (WhatsApp +91 9110566354)

## Training and workshops
- [Android app (direct download, APK)](https://www.egirerobotics.com/app): the EGIRE Robotics app with the programs, the lessons, the offline Electronics Atlas and, for accepted students, the CRM
- [Programs: workshops, internships and training](https://www.egirerobotics.com/workshops): open now are the FPV Drone Engineering Programme and an online drone internship; college workshops with certificates from Rs 7,999; DGCA and robotics programs coming soon
- [Enquire or book a demo](https://www.egirerobotics.com/enquire)
- [About EGIRE Robotics](https://www.egirerobotics.com/about)

## Brochures (PDF downloads)
- [FPV Drone Engineering Programme brochure](https://www.egirerobotics.com/downloads/egirerobotics-engineering-brochure.pdf): 50 days, 5 hands-on labs, build analog and digital FPV drones, for engineering students and graduates
- [Online Internship brochure: Drone Technology and Pilot Training](https://www.egirerobotics.com/downloads/egirerobotics-online-internship-brochure.pdf): 45 days, 100% online, 7 modules, simulator based, completion certificate

## Academy (free with sign-in)
FPV piloting, PID tuning, drone hardware, drone physics, wiring lab and a drone configurator, taught with interactive 3D lessons.
